description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Shipwreck Dowser triggers, getting +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser with haste.
The token copy of Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
